lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in four visible horizontal rows along the central flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a consistent grid-like arrangement across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible linear feature running horizontally along the mid-flank with a distinct luminance gradient: high-intensity on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of 4-6 high-luminance spots on the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, affected by surface refraction blur.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct pattern of smaller, high-density white spots on the distal portion of the pectoral fin visible in the lower right quadrant.
